{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter completed orders (as defined in contract)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float after removing commas
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (including QA orders, as per contract)
mean_revenue_including_qa = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (including QA orders): {mean_revenue_including_qa}")"}
